== Usage ==
{{<nowiki/>Keyboard|'''''key='''''|'''''colorKey'''''|'''''color#'''''|'''''color#descr'''''}}
* key: key name (e.g F1, Esc, P) see the {{Link|#Full Template}} for all the keys.
* color''Key'': (Optional, default empty) key color definition, e.g {{hl|c= colorP= #CDF}}
* color#: (Optional, default empty) color code (e.g {{hl|c= color1= #CDF}}) range 1..10
* color#desc: (Optional, default empty) color description (e.g color1desc= Movement) range 1..10
